svg.title: Multi-Team Agentic Orchestration
svg.desc: Left-to-right 3-tier tree diagram: 1 Orchestrator dispatches to 3 Team Leads, each of which coordinates 3 Workers — a multi-team agentic engineering system. Animation: 15s cycle — cinematic reveal (0–4s), traveling dots along all 12 edges with node highlight flashes at departure and arrival (4–9s), then loops.
